verdict.rationale: Vapi documents Composer, where you "describe what you want to build and Composer handles the technical setup". That is the platform's own AI building an agent from a description, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is a single thin doc line, though. It does not show prompt improvement, flow generation, or AI-generated test cases; Voice Test Suites and Evals are user-defined test frameworks, not AI-authored ones. Missing for 10: AI prompt refinement/improvement, AI-generated flows/workflows, AI-generated test cases from a description, in-depth Composer documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
